title: AX Filter managed configuration
description: Enterprise policy for the AX Filter extension. Values set here are read-only, take precedence over per-user settings, and let an administrator preconfigure the inspection server and fail mode via Chrome enterprise policy.

apiBase.title: Server URL
apiBase.description: Base URL of the AX Filter inspection server, e.g. https://axfilter.example.com (no trailing slash). The extension calls <apiBase>/v1/inspect.

apiKey.title: Agent API key
apiKey.description: Value sent as the X-API-Key header (agent role). Optional; set only if the organization distributes a shared agent key via policy.

enabled.title: Inspection enabled
enabled.description: When true, prompts are inspected before sending. When false, the extension does not intercept.

failMode.title: Behavior when the server is unreachable
failMode.description: block = hold the prompt (fail safe); allow = send anyway.
